name: Matoi Ayame
source:
Ayame is a 3rd year high school student and is one of the best elements of the school. Beautiful and intelligent, she has always been exemplary in the performance of her student duties, unlike her childhood friend [url=/c68616]Riho[/url]. Although more mature than most girls of her age, Ayame is quite childish, ecstatic about food or losing herself in supermarkets... 

Her parents are long-time friends of the Tachibanaki family as well as being their neighbours. So she became quite naturally friends with Riho and [url=/c68619]Keisuke[/url] very early in their childhood. Due to their work, her parents will have to leave for a few months to settle in London.
